description: Stocktaking overview: without sessionId lists all stocktaking sessions with live progress; with sessionId returns the per-location and per-counter breakdown of that session. Reading results: "pending" = not yet counted, "missing" = counted as absent — a session can be CLOSED with missing items (missing > 0 while pending = 0 is a completed count that found items missing, not a contradiction). Sessions carry a `name` — identify one to your user by that; the `id` is a machine handle for your next call, not something to read aloud.
name: stocktaking_status

sessions.description: All stocktaking sessions — only in the no-argument mode

totals.description: Org-wide counters for one session (expected, confirmed, …)
